results.title: Baramulti reports USD63.01 million net profit for Q2 2026, EPS rises to USD0.0241 and shares gain 0.41 %
results.body: Baramulti posted a net profit of USD63.01 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, a 26.85 % increase from USD49.67 million a year earlier, and earnings per share rose to USD0,0241 from USD0,0190. Revenue grew 10.62 % to USD361.06 million, while gross profit climbed to USD134.87 million. Operating profit rose to USD79.7 million and net financial income increased to USD1.39 million. The stock closed 0.41 % higher at Rp4,930, contributing to a 22.94 % year‑to‑date gain.

results.title: Maybank Sekuritas Maintains Buy Rating and Rp 4,700 Target Price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk as Nickel Business Drives Growth
results.body: Maybank Sekuritas maintained a buy recommendation and a Rp 4,700 target price for PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, citing strengthening nickel contributions that offset a normalization in gold earnings. In the first half of 2026, the company posted a 36% year-on-year increase in net profit to Rp 6.39 trillion, driven by a 420% surge in ferronickel sales volume and a 50% rise in nickel ore average selling price to US$81.6 per wet metric ton. The broker projects 2026 revenue of Rp 130.53 trillion and net profit of Rp 9.26 trillion, with nickel volume and price gains expected to counterbalance a slowdown in precious metals trading.

results.title: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk's Sustainable Financing Portfolio Reaches IDR 19.23 Trillion, 17.3% of Total Credit by June 2026
results.body: PT Bank Maybank Indonesia Tbk reported that its sustainable financing portfolio has reached IDR 19.23 trillion as of June 2026, accounting for 17.3% of the bank’s total credit portfolio. The bank highlighted its commitment to circular‑economy initiatives, including upcycling of post‑consumer plastics, textile fibers and printed materials into new products. President Director Steffano Ridwan said the effort aims to deliver lasting positive impact for society and the environment. Maybank Indonesia also launched a two‑year “Cahaya Kasih” volunteer program to support six Adiwiyata‑certified elementary schools in the Greater Jakarta area, targeting 500 volunteers, 60 teachers, 3,000 students and 1,500 community members.

results.title: PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk confirms settlement of principal obligations in Navios lawsuit, shares close up 7.69%
results.body: PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk confirmed that it has fully paid the principal obligations underlying the performance‑breach lawsuit filed by Navios Control Services Pte. Ltd., although the legal case remains pending. The company said it reconciled and verified the ship‑maintenance invoices and settled all outstanding vendor bills directly. Management emphasized that the settlement does not materially affect its operations, financial condition, or business continuity. On Friday, 4 September 2026, PT Cakra Buana Resources Energi Tbk’s shares closed up 7.69% at Rp 770, reflecting a five‑day gain of 12.41%.

results.title: PT Intiland Development Commissioner Sinarto Dharmawan sold 32.9 million shares while major shareholder Lo Kheng Hong retained a 7.5% stake.
results.body: PT Intiland Development Tbk saw a shareholding change as commissioner Sinarto Dharmawan sold 32,883,780 shares on August 21, 2026 at Rp116 per share, reducing his ownership from 0.33% to 0.01%. The transaction generated approximately Rp3.81 billion in proceeds for Sinarto. Meanwhile, prominent investor Lo Kheng Hong continued to hold 7.50% (777,135,700 shares) as of September 3, 2026, joining three other shareholders with stakes above 5%: Hope Diamond Management Ltd (22.85%), Bali Private Villa (S) Pte Ltd (7.48%), and Bank of Singapore Limited (5.00%). On September 4, DILD shares closed at 121, down 0.82% or 1 point.

results.title: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk completes transfer of 19.81 million buyback shares, stock up 30%
results.body: PT Perintis Triniti Properti Tbk completed the mandatory transfer of all 19.81 million shares repurchased under its buyback program, selling the shares on the Indonesia Stock Exchange between 3 August and 27 August 2026. The transactions were executed at average prices ranging from Rp 296.62 to a peak of Rp 350.74 per share, with the final tranche sold at Rp 334. Following the completion, the company's stock rose 17.51% to Rp 416 on 4 September 2026, reflecting a 30% gain over the preceding month. The buyback had originally been conducted at an average price of Rp 280 per share.

results.title: Winner Nusantara Increases Stake in Laxo Global Akses to 90% Targeting Recurring Income
results.body: PT Winner Nusantara Jaya Tbk (WINR) has agreed to increase its ownership in PT Laxo Global Akses from 60% to 90% through an addendum to the share acquisition agreement signed on September 2, 2026. The property developer aims to gain greater control over the internet service provider and create recurring income by bundling connectivity services with its property projects. Laxo Global Akses currently serves over 100 corporate and government clients plus more than 10,000 retail customers across approximately 30 major Indonesian cities. WINR shares rose 8.7% to Rp 25 on September 4, 2026, extending a five-day gain of 25%.

results.title: Indonesia's gigawatt-scale data centre expansion requires financing beyond bank lending, experts say
results.body: Indonesia's target to reach 1.7 gigawatts of data centre capacity by 2026 translates to an estimated US$17 billion investment need, which industry leaders say exceeds the lending capacity of banks alone. Recent syndicated loans include Rp6.7 trillion from Bank DBS Indonesia and Bank UOB Indonesia for the DayOne-INA campus in Batam, Rp17 trillion from PT Bank Central Asia Tbk for PT DCI Indonesia Tbk in May 2026, and Rp8.8 trillion from a syndicate of PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk, PT Bank HSBC Indonesia, and PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk for STT GDC Indonesia in June 2026. JPMorgan Indonesia CEO Gioshia Ralie states that bank financing has inherent limits and must be combined with capital market instruments, a view echoed by IDPRO Chairman Hendra Suryakusuma, who notes that bank loans remain crucial for construction but that operational assets can attract institutional investors, infrastructure funds, and green financing. Gioshia adds that this blended financing model is already established in the United States and can be replicated in Indonesia.

results.title: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk reports Q2 2026 net profit of Rp31.2 trillion amid healthy expansion
results.body: PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk reported a consolidated net profit of Rp31.2 trillion for the second quarter of 2026, up 17.5% year‑on‑year, with total assets reaching Rp2,352 trillion, a rise of 11.7% YoY. Credit disbursement grew 16.2% YoY to Rp1,646 trillion while key asset‑quality ratios improved, with the non‑performing loan ratio falling to 2.9% from 3.0%, the loan‑at‑risk ratio improving to 9.1% from 9.6%, and the cost of credit decreasing to 3.1% from 3.4%. The bank attributes the results to its selective growth strategy, disciplined risk management and a diversified UMKM‑focused portfolio that keeps expansion within its risk appetite.

results.title: Chairul Tanjung Explains Rationale for Allo Bank (BBHI) Share Buyback Amid Market Pressure
results.body: Chairul Tanjung, owner of PT Allo Bank Indonesia Tbk (BBHI), explained that the bank's planned share buyback of up to Rp300 billion from September 3 to December 2, 2026, aims to support the share price amid market pressure. The buyback shares will be held as treasury stock under POJK No. 29/2023, and management says it will not materially affect business or liquidity, with proforma assets declining to Rp15.27 trillion from Rp15.57 trillion and equity to Rp7.04 trillion from Rp7.34 trillion if fully utilized. Allo Bank's share price closed at Rp900 on September 4, 2026, down 39.6% year-to-date and 43.93% year-on-year. In the first half of 2026, the bank posted net interest income of Rp771.1 billion, up 15.1% annually, net profit of Rp233.6 billion, up 2.9%, and loan growth of 27.5% to Rp9.54 trillion with a non-performing loan ratio of 1.73%. Tanjung added that Allo Bank's capitalization is sufficient, with core capital at Rp7.24 trillion as of June 2026, and there are no immediate plans for a rights issue or an upgrade to KBMI III.

results.title: Weekly Top Gainers and Losers: SINI Surges Sharply, RGAS and VKTR Decline
results.body: The article reviews the weekly top gainers and losers on the Indonesia Stock Exchange for the week of August 31 to September 4, 2026. PT Singaraja Putra Tbk (SINI) rose 50.65% to Rp14,500 after PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk (CUAN) announced acquisition negotiations, while PT Olympus Strategic Indonesia Tbk (NATO) led gainers with an 84.67% increase to Rp1,265 amid internal discussions on a potential bond issuance. On the downside, PT Kian Santang Muliatama Tbk (RGAS) fell 38.14% to Rp120 after its parent PT Kian Megah Investama sold 13.92 million shares at Rp253 on August 26, reducing its stake from 9.64% to 8.68%. PT VKTR Teknologi Mobilitas Tbk (VKTR) declined 10.36% to Rp865.

results.title: PT Bukit Asam Tbk reports strong 1H 2026 earnings and 13.8% share price rise on foreign net buying
results.body: PT Bukit Asam Tbk, a state‑owned coal producer (BUMN), reported a strong first‑half 2026 performance, with revenue of Rp 22.03 trillion up 8% YoY and net profit of Rp 2.65 trillion, delivering a 12% net profit margin and 19% EBITDA margin. Production rose 94% QoQ and sales increased 8% QoQ, while average selling price grew 14% QoQ and 10% YoY, supported by a 49% export share to Vietnam, Bangladesh, Cambodia, India and Thailand. Foreign investors accumulated a net buy of Rp 57.97 billion in the week of 31 Aug–4 Sep 2026, driving the share price to jump 13.83% and close at Rp 2,880, a 24.14% gain over the past month. Capital expenditure reached 30% of the annual target, amounting to Rp 1.09 trillion.

results.title: PT Gudang Garam Tbk appoints Adhi Wibhawa Wonowidjojo as new commissioner
results.body: PT Gudang Garam Tbk held its 2025 annual general meeting on 23 June 2026 and approved the appointment of Adhi Wibhawa Wonowidjojo as a new commissioner. The appointment takes effect immediately and will run until the next AGM in 2030, covering the remainder of the current term. Adhi, who joined the company in 2025 as assistant secretary to the board, was promoted to the board after roughly one year of service. He joins a board that includes Juni Setiawati Wonowidjojo as principal commissioner, Susilo Wonowidjojo as director, and Indra Gunawan Wonowidjojo as vice director.

results.title: PT Sunindo Pratama Tbk wins third Pertamina EP tender, poised to earn Rp56.4 billion
results.body: PT Sunindo Pratama Tbk was awarded a US$3.19 million (Rp56.4 billion) contract by PT Pertamina EP on 4 September 2026 to supply 13 3/8‑inch low‑grade casing for Regional 1, marking SUNI’s third Pertamina tender win in three months. The six‑month‑plus deal, priced at an exchange rate of Rp17,650 per US$, adds to SUNI’s cumulative Pertamina contracts of Rp162.7 billion, which include earlier wellhead and Christmas‑tree orders of Rp62.55 billion and Rp43.74 billion. SUNI reported OCTG sales of 4,230 tons in Q1 2026 (19% of its annual target), with casing contributing about 27% of revenue, while its wellhead & Christmas‑tree segment, produced through subsidiary PT Petro Synergy Manufacturing, accounted for roughly 10% of total business and is on track to meet a 2026 target of 142 units (70 units delivered in Q1). The company imports the casing using Chinese yuan (RMB) to offset US$ strength and expects the new contract to lift revenue and profitability in 2027, reinforcing its position for future Pertamina projects.

results.title: PT Modernland Realty Tbk schedules second extraordinary shareholders meeting to seek approval for asset transfer exceeding 50% of net assets
results.body: PT Modernland Realty Tbk (MDLN) announced it will convene a second extraordinary shareholders meeting (RUPSLB) to obtain shareholder approval for a proposed transfer, disposition or guarantee of assets valued at more than 50% of the company's net assets. The first RUPSLB held on 4 September 2026 failed to meet the quorum required under POJK No. 15/POJK.04/2020, prompting the scheduling of the second meeting to be held between 10 and 21 days after the initial session. During the same meeting, shareholders approved an amendment to Article 3 of the company's Articles of Association to align its business activities with the latest Indonesian industry classification and related regulations. The company, described in the article as the property issuer, also granted its board of directors authority to implement the approved changes.

results.title: Waskita Karya (WSKT) Secures Bond Restructuring Approval, Sets Stage for Stock Suspension Lift
results.body: PT Waskita Karya (Persero) Tbk (WSKT) held a bondholders' meeting that approved the full restructuring of its 2019 Obligasi III Tahap IV, paving the way for the Bursa Efek Indonesia to lift its stock suspension. The company has cut its total debt by 20.8% to Rp 66.5 trillion and reduced vendor past‑due debt by 97.1% to Rp 48 billion, while fully settling past‑due tax liabilities. Revenue for the first half of 2026 rose 58.49% year‑on‑year to Rp 4.92 trillion, and new contract value reached Rp 5.1 trillion, dominated by connectivity projects (45.6%) and water infrastructure (21.7%). Waskita Karya remains focused on core contracting work and is in ongoing dialogue with Danantara Indonesia to support its recovery and growth.

results.title: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk seeks to increase stake in PT Singaraja Putra Tbk to become controlling shareholder
results.body: PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk is negotiating to raise its ownership in PT Singaraja Putra Tbk from the current 27.78% to become the largest shareholder and take control of the mining‑focused firm. PT Singaraja Putra Tbk also plans to acquire almost all of PT Karya Mineral Sentosa from PT Petrosea Tbk in a deal valued at Rp1.73 triliun. PT Petrosea Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk, providing mining services. The transactions increase PT Petrindo Jaya Kreasi Tbk’s exposure to the mining sector and consolidate its control over PT Singaraja Putra Tbk’s operations.

results.title: BTPN Syariah Plans Rp1 Trillion Share Buyback, Seeks Shareholder Approval at October EGM
results.body: PT Bank BTPN Syariah Tbk announced a plan to repurchase shares worth up to Rp1 trillion, aiming to boost trading liquidity and reflect fundamental value. The buyback, funded entirely from equity, will not exceed 10% of paid-up capital and requires approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 13 October 2026, with a 12-month execution period starting 14 October 2026. The bank's solid financial position is underscored by a 2025 dividend of Rp660.21 billion (54.96% payout ratio), unrestricted retained earnings of Rp6.89 trillion, and first-half 2026 net profit of Rp655 billion. Assets grew 8% year-on-year to Rp23 trillion, financing disbursement rose 9% to Rp11 trillion, with ROA at 7.2% and CAR at 58.7%.

results.title: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk Announces Integrated Sugar Manufacturing Expansion and New Brown Sugar Plant
results.body: PT Aman Agrindo Tbk is shifting from a trade‑focused model to an integrated sugar producer by constructing a new brown‑sugar plant in Banten and seeking to acquire an operating sugar mill in Sragen. For the six months ended 30 June 2026 the company posted sales of Rp 144.32 billion, up 121.6% year‑on‑year, with net profit of Rp 34.84 million after a loss of Rp 1.62 billion a year earlier, while operating profit rose to Rp 5.77 billion and financial expenses were Rp 5.35 billion. Management expects the Banten plant to commence commercial production in Q4 2026, operate at 90‑95% capacity, and lift revenue by 25‑30% with manufacturing contributing about 25% of total revenue within two to three years. The targeted acquisition of the Sragen mill would add roughly 1,000 tons of daily cane‑crushing capacity (about 200% of current capacity), potentially increasing revenue by 35‑40% (≈Rp 175 billion) and adding around Rp 50 billion of EBITDA annually.

results.title: PT Sunindo Pratama Tbk Wins US$3.19 Million Tender from PT Pertamina EP
results.body: PT Sunindo Pratama Tbk announced it has been awarded a tender from PT Pertamina EP to supply 13 3/8‑inch low‑grade casing for the Pertamina Regional I Sumatra area. The contract is valued at US$3.19 million (approximately Rp56.23 billion) and will be executed over six months and 50 calendar days. Sunindo also previously secured a Rp43.74 billion wellhead and Xmas Tree supply tender from Pertamina EP and a Rp62.55 billion wellhead component tender from PT Pertamina Hulu Rokan, with contract periods of 1 year 4 months 50 days and from 20 Aug 2026 to 19 Aug 2028 respectively. Management expects the new award to boost Sunindo’s revenue and profitability in 2027 and strengthen its position for future projects.
